title: Synthetic example — workstation to server incident
subtitle: Demonstration data only; no connection to a real case

events.title: An attachment delivers a script
events.summary: A downloaded attachment introduces the script to a workstation.
events.technical: Browser download and file creation records identify the same script path.
evidence: Synthetic browser record 10; synthetic file record 20

events.title: The script runs on the workstation
events.summary: Process records show the script being launched.
events.technical: Process telemetry records the interpreter and script path; this is an execution observation.

events.title: Activity reaches a server
events.summary: Correlated source and server records establish a remote command session.
events.technical: Source connection and destination authentication plus command execution share account and session context.
evidence: Synthetic source connection 40; synthetic server session 50 and execution 51

events.title: An upload target appears
events.summary: An upload command references storage; completed transfer is unconfirmed.
events.technical: Command telemetry names the storage target. No receiver acknowledgement or completed transfer record is present.

events.title: Containment time remains unknown
events.summary: This example contains no verified response action or completion time.
events.technical: Response records would be needed to place containment on the incident timeline.
